description: This Java class 'ReferencePlaceholder' extracts and holds information about referenced entities from placeholder strings, including pattern matching, entity type, ID, and field references.

classes.name: ReferencePlaceholder
classes.description: Immutable class that parses and stores reference placeholder details such as entity type, ID, and field.

classes.name: ReferencePlaceholder.ReferencedEntityType
classes.description: Enum representing supported referenced entity types, currently only 'THINGS'.

methods.name: fromCharSequence
methods.description: Parses input string to create a ReferencePlaceholder instance if pattern matches.

methods.name: getReferencedEntityType
methods.description: Returns the type of the referenced entity.

methods.name: getReferencedEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the referenced entity.

methods.name: getReferencedField
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer to the referenced field.
